description:
Evidence-aware comparison emitted by `archlens compare --explain`. Uses reconciliation wording, never causality (plan section 15.4). This is a DERIVED, explicitly non-authoritative output (plan section 3.3). It carries an independent format version and must never be read back as measurement evidence.

1.1 exists because 1.0 predated fields the command already emits, while declaring `additionalProperties: false` — so every real invocation violated the schema that claimed to describe it. Nothing validated the output, so the drift was invisible. The emitted payload is the intended interface; 1.0 is retained unchanged as historical material and is not the current contract. (finding F-P3-8)

invalid_artifacts.description: Human-readable reasons either run could not be admitted for comparison. Non-empty drives the invalid-artifacts exit code, so it is load-bearing output rather than commentary.

run_a_id.description: Run id of the baseline run, or null if unrecorded.

run_b_id.description: Run id of the candidate run, or null if unrecorded.

title: ArchLens compare output 1.1
